Cameras, installed in September 2025 and never formally activated, were covered pending removal; Flock began removing them in January 2026.

decision_summary: City council voted to end the Flock contract (reported 4-2 vote; one source dates the vote May 27); formal termination letter made the cancellation effective June 29, 2026. The single operating camera had been switched off in February 2026 after reports that federal and out-of-state agencies searched Oregon Flock networks.
